summary: 读入小写单词数组words，长度在1到15000之间，每个单词长度在1到10之间。下标为i的单词权重就是i。随后回答至多与单词个数相同的询问。每次询问给出一个前缀和一个后缀，两者长度都在0到10之间，并且只含小写字母。找出同时以该前缀开头、以该后缀结尾的单词中权重最大的一个，写出它的权重。没有匹配时写出-1。

samples.stdin:
many words, words[i] has weight i.

Design a class WordFilter that supports one function, WordFilter.f(String prefix, String suffix). It will
samples.stdout:
the word with given prefix and suffix with maximum weight. If no word exists, return -1.

Examples:

Input:
WordFilter(["apple"])
WordFilter.f("a", "e") // returns 0
WordFilter.f("b", "") // returns -1

Note:

1. words has length in range [1, 15000].
2. For each test case, up to words.length queries WordFilter.f may be made.
3. words[i] has length in range [1, 10].
4. prefix, suffix have lengths in range [0, 10].
5. words[i] and prefix, suffix queries consist of lowercase letters only.
samples.note: 左侧是这一则的输入文本，右侧是程序应该打印的文本。对照时去掉末尾连续换行。
